input.user_message: Talking-to-camera edit of Lucas, our waiter at Don Julio. Start at my "What's your name?" and end right after the "Cheers!", drop all the table chatter after it. Captions for every voice. Spell the sauces right: salsa criolla, chimichurri. I didn't catch the third sauce he names: if you can't tell what he says, ask me instead of guessing. Put a "LUCAS" name tag when he says his name, and "CHIMICHURRI" in big letters when he says chimichurri. Title: "Sauce check at Don Julio". No text on faces. About 15 seconds.
